target.statement: MLR model for total discharge (TD) on H-Top layout: test R2 = 0.72 (and train R2 = 0.96) with coefficients λ0=11.3, λ1=-0.46, λ2=0.025, λ3=0.025
target.dataset: 36 experimental flume tests (18 H-Top layout tests), Movasat & Tomac 2024 lab data

compute.basis: Fitting a 4-feature multiple linear regression on 18 rows is seconds of CPU work; the only real cost is obtaining the tabulated experimental data, which is not released.

blockers: Data 'available upon reasonable request' — not publicly downloadable
No code or repository linked in the paper
Only 18 data points; exact train/test split (65/35) and random seed not specified, so exact R2/MSE values are not reproducible without the raw data
title: Predicting the post-wildfire mudflow onset using machine learning models on multi-parameter experimental data
